title: Hanuma declares himself to be a messenger of
introduction: As instructed by Ravana, Prahasta his chief minister inquires of Hanuma as to who he was and also his motive in destroying the pleasure-garden as also killing the demons. In reply, Hanuma says that he destroyed the pleasure-garden in order that he might be taken captive and dragged to the presence of Ravana, whom he was eager to see and was forced in self-defense to kill those who stood in his way. Finally, he declares himself to be a messenger of Rama and adds that, though he was incapable of being bound by a missile presided over by Brahma, he surrendered to it only in order to see Ravana in person.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे पङ्चाशः सर्गः
Thus completes 50th Chapter of Sundara Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
तम् उद्वीक्ष्य महाबाहुः पिन्ग अक्षम् पुरतः स्थितम् |
रोषेण महता आविष्टो रावणो लोक रावणः
स राजा रोष ताम्र अक्षः प्रहस्तम् मन्त्रि सत्तमम् |
verses.iast:
tam udvīkṣya mahābāhuḥ pinga akṣam purataḥ sthitam |
roṣeṇa mahatā āviṣṭo rāvaṇo loka rāvaṇaḥ
sa rājā roṣa tāmra akṣaḥ prahastam mantri sattamam |
verses.translation: That Ravana, the long-armed, who caused people to cry, looking up at that monkey standing in front of him, was affected with violent anger, having his mind seized with suspicion, speculated (as follows) about Hanuma, the jewel among the monkeys, who was invested with splendour.

glosses.meaning: who causes the people to cry
with his mind seized with suspicion
about Hanuma the formost of monkeys

verses.devanagari:
किमेष भगवान्नन्दी भवेत्साक्षादिहागतः
येन शप्तोऽस्मि कैलासे मया संचालिते पुरा |
सोऽयम् वानरमूर्तिः स्यात्किंस्विद्बाणो महासुरः
verses.iast:
kimeṣa bhagavānnandī bhavetsākṣādihāgataḥ
yena śapto'smi kailāse mayā saṃcālite purā |
so'yam vānaramūrtiḥ syātkiṃsvidbāṇo mahāsuraḥ
verses.translation: "When Mount Kailasa was moved by me, is it the same Nandi the divine bull (attendant of Siva) which cursed me long ago and came here now in this form or whether he is Bana the great demon (son of Bali) came here in the form of a monkey."

glosses.meaning: in the form of a monkey.

verses.devanagari:
स राजा रोषताम्राक्षः प्रहस्तम् मन्त्रिसत्तमम् |
काल युक्तम् उवाच इदम् वचो विपुलम् अर्थवत्
verses.iast:
sa rājā roṣatāmrākṣaḥ prahastam mantrisattamam |
kāla yuktam uvāca idam vaco vipulam arthavat
verses.translation: That king Ravana, becoming enraged with red hot eyes, spoke the following concise and meaningful words relevant to that occasion, to Prahasta, his chief of ministers.

verses.devanagari:
दुरात्मा पृच्छ्यताम् एष कुतः किम् वा अस्य कारणम् |
वन भन्गे च को अस्य अर्थो राक्षसीनाम् च तर्जने
verses.iast:
durātmā pṛcchyatām eṣa kutaḥ kim vā asya kāraṇam |
vana bhange ca ko asya artho rākṣasīnām ca tarjane
verses.translation: "Ask this wicked monkey from where did he come, for what reason did he come to this place and for what purpose did he frighten the female-demons in destroying our garden."

glosses.meaning: let this wicked one be asked

verses.devanagari:
मत्पुरीमप्रधृष्याम् वागमने किं प्रयोजनम् |
आयोधने वाकिं कार्यम् पृच्छ्यतामेष दुर्मतिः
verses.iast:
matpurīmapradhṛṣyām vāgamane kiṃ prayojanam |
āyodhane vākiṃ kāryam pṛcchyatāmeṣa durmatiḥ
verses.translation: "Ask this evil-minded monkey as to what really is his purpose in coming over to my invincible City and what pursuit he is doing this battle."

glosses.meaning: let this evil-minded monkey be asked

verses.devanagari:
रावणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा प्रहस्तो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् |
समाश्वसिहि भद्रम् ते न भीः कार्या त्वया कपे
verses.iast:
rāvaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā prahasto vākyam abravīt |
samāśvasihi bhadram te na bhīḥ kāryā tvayā kape
verses.translation: Hearing the words of Ravana, Prahasta spoke the following words to Hanuma, "Take courage! Happiness to you! You need not get frightened, O monkey!"

verses.devanagari:
यदि तावत् त्वम् इन्द्रेण प्रेषितो रावण आलयम् |
तत्त्वम् आख्याहि मा ते भूत् भयम् वानर मोक्ष्यसे
verses.iast:
yadi tāvat tvam indreṇa preṣito rāvaṇa ālayam |
tattvam ākhyāhi mā te bhūt bhayam vānara mokṣyase
verses.translation: "O monkey! If Indra has sent you to the abode of Ravana, tell me the truth. Do not have fear. You will be released."

verses.devanagari:
यदि वैश्रवणस्य त्वम् यमस्य वरुणस्य च |
चारु रूपम् इदम् कृत्वा ओरवुष्टो नः पुरीमिमाम्
विष्णुना प्रेषितो वा अपि दूतो विजय कान्क्षिणा |
verses.iast:
yadi vaiśravaṇasya tvam yamasya varuṇasya ca |
cāru rūpam idam kṛtvā oravuṣṭo naḥ purīmimām
viṣṇunā preṣito vā api dūto vijaya kānkṣiṇā |
verses.translation: "Are you, the one who has entered our city, assuming the guise of a spy, sent by Kubera the god of riches or by Yama the god of death or by Varuna the lord of the sea or whether sent by Vishnu the lord of preservation, as a messenger, longing for a victory?"

glosses.meaning: belonging to Kubera the lord of riches
or belonging to Yama the god of death
or belonging to Varuna the Lord of the sea

verses.devanagari:
न हि ते वानरम् तेजो रूप मात्रम् तु वानरम्
तत्त्वतः कथयस्व अद्य ततो वानर मोक्ष्यसे |
verses.iast:
na hi te vānaram tejo rūpa mātram tu vānaram
tattvataḥ kathayasva adya tato vānara mokṣyase |
verses.translation: "O monkey! Your form alone is that of a monkey. Your splendour indeed is not that of a monkey. Now, tell me the truth. Thereupon, you will be released."

verses.devanagari:
अनृतम् वदतः च अपि दुर्लभम् तव जीवितम्
अथवा यन् निमित्तः ते प्रवेशो रावण आलये |
verses.iast:
anṛtam vadataḥ ca api durlabham tava jīvitam
athavā yan nimittaḥ te praveśo rāvaṇa ālaye |
verses.translation: "If you tell a lie, your survival will be difficult. Or else, tell me the purpose of your entry into Ravana's abode."

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्तो हरि वरः तदा रक्षो गण ईश्वरम्
अब्रवीन् न अस्मि शक्रस्य यमस्य वरुणस्य वा |
धनदेन न मे सख्यम् विष्णुना न अस्मि चोदितः
जातिः एव मम तु एषा वानरो अहम् इह आगतः |
verses.iast:
evam ukto hari varaḥ tadā rakṣo gaṇa īśvaram
abravīn na asmi śakrasya yamasya varuṇasya vā |
dhanadena na me sakhyam viṣṇunā na asmi coditaḥ
jātiḥ eva mama tu eṣā vānaro aham iha āgataḥ |
verses.translation: Hearing the words of Prahasta, Hanuma spoke to Ravana the Lord of demons as follows, "I am not a messenger of Indra or Yama or Varuna. I have no friendship with Kubera the god of riches, nor am I instigated by Vishnu. This is just my form of existence, by my very birth. I am a monkey who came here."

glosses.meaning: to Ravana the Lord of demons
with Kubera the god of riches

verses.devanagari:
दर्शने राक्षस इन्द्रस्य दुर्लभे तत् इदम् मया
वनम् राक्षस राजस्य दर्शन अर्थे विनाशितम् |
verses.iast:
darśane rākṣasa indrasya durlabhe tat idam mayā
vanam rākṣasa rājasya darśana arthe vināśitam |
verses.translation: "The sight of Ravana the King of demons is difficult to be obtained. Intent on that object (of sight of Ravana), the garden was destroyed by me."

verses.devanagari:
ततः ते राक्षसाः प्राप्ता बलिनो युद्ध कान्क्षिणः
रक्षण अर्थम् च देहस्य प्रतियुद्धा मया रणे |
verses.iast:
tataḥ te rākṣasāḥ prāptā balino yuddha kānkṣiṇaḥ
rakṣaṇa artham ca dehasya pratiyuddhā mayā raṇe |
verses.translation: "Then, those strong demons came with a desire to fight with me. Just for protecting my body, I had to attack them in battle."

verses.devanagari:
अस्त्र पाशैः न शक्यो अहम् बद्धुम् देव असुरैः अपि
पितामहात् एव वरो मम अपि एषो अभ्युपागतः |
verses.iast:
astra pāśaiḥ na śakyo aham baddhum deva asuraiḥ api
pitāmahāt eva varo mama api eṣo abhyupāgataḥ |
verses.translation: "I am incapable of being bound by missiles and nooses even by celestials and demons. This boon came to me also from Brahama only."

verses.devanagari:
राजानम् द्रष्टु कामेन मया अस्त्रम् अनुवर्तितम्
विमुक्तो अहम् अस्त्रेण राक्षसैः तु अतिपीडितः |
केवचिद्राजकार्येण सम्प्राप्तोऽस्मि तवान्तिकम्
verses.iast:
rājānam draṣṭu kāmena mayā astram anuvartitam
vimukto aham astreṇa rākṣasaiḥ tu atipīḍitaḥ |
kevacidrājakāryeṇa samprāpto'smi tavāntikam
verses.translation: With a desire to see you the king, I surrendered to the missile. Soon after bound by the demons, I was indeed released from the missile. I came to your presence, prompted by some mission of Rama."

verses.devanagari:
दूतोऽहमिति विज्ञेयो राघवस्यामितौजसः |
श्रूयताम् चापि वचनम् मम पथ्यमिदम् प्रभो
verses.iast:
dūto'hamiti vijJṇeyo rāghavasyāmitaujasaḥ |
śrūyatām cāpi vacanam mama pathyamidam prabho
verses.translation: "O, Lord of demons! Know me to be a messenger of Rama who is possessing I am unlimited splendour. I am telling you a beneficial word. Listen to it."
